notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.215 Summer's Day!
notes.notes:
As the sun blazes high and the days grow longer, we’re excited to bring back our summer events!  This update is all about embracing the joys of summer with a wave of exciting new content, sizzling adventures, and refreshing changes that will make your gaming experience even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into the highlights of this sun-soaked update!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24cee6d262355c0517d03e52f58caab05d2ac91c.jpg"]
Holiday Dodo is BACK!
Players can obtain Casual Beachwear/Crab Beachwear/Beach Lounger upon defeating Holiday Dodos at:  Pixark：Novice Grassland/Grassland Skyward：Dawn Island/Woodland 


Summer Sports event back! 
This update is packed with exciting content, vibrant summer events, and thrilling sports challenges designed to keep the heat of competition alive. Whether you’re diving into intense sports events, participating in friendly matches, or enjoying the seasonal festivities, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.   



Items：
Javelin：
-	Primitive Skill, learned at lv6, crafted by hand.
-	Throwing a javelin at a training dummy at a distance will send you a report to your inventory containing results.
-	Medals will be rewarded based on the results: alongside medals as rewards based on the results:
20-50m: Bronze
50-80m: Silver
80-104.8m: Gold
Results beyond 104.8m will be invalid.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/fa455b0ccc946d2bcc8c91f0775839303fc86377.png"]Roadblock Cone:
-  Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 2 silver medals

Hurdle ：
-  Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 2 silver medals
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1671cf147f451a0dede04f04bd8df064eb024356.png"]

Track Suits：
-  Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center:
Head/Hands: 4 silver medals
Top: 6 silver medals & 2 gold medals
Bottom/Shoes: 5 silver medals & 1 gold medal
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/946f35c43509e921978ed4708933579150ee5b69.jpg"]Old Events Are Back!
-Boxing Match
Even the creatures are eager for a match during this blazing summer! Explorers can make Boxing Gloves through recipes (lv6) to challenge creatures wearing boxing gloves, which will drop different medals. 
-Gold Medal Challenge: Boxling Cyclops
-Silver Medal Challenge: Boxing Giant Claw Mole
-Bronze Medal Challenge: Boxing Kairuku

Explorers can use the metals they obtain to exchange items at the Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/97ecdd6851960d556ae5c5e3249fcc8cb7da7d44.gif"] Summer Trophy Hat
Explorers will have a chance obtaining a Summer Trophy Hat for their tamed creatures by defeating wild creatures wearing the hat. 
- 20% chance of looting the hat, and 80% chance of looting a bronze medal.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/70455fe0f27a17d2a8cb244dfbf512ee22383514.jpg"]Boxing Cyclops
Spawn Area：Doomlands，Black Rock Mountain，Frozen Land，Crystal Island
Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
30% chance of obtaining 1 gold medal
70% chance of obtaining 2-5 silver medals

Boxing Giant Claw Mole
Spawn Area：Grassland，Woodland，Desert，Twilight Forest

Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
30% chance of obtaining 2 silver medals
70% chance of obtaining 2-5 bronze medals

Boxing Kairuku
Spawn Area：Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland. 
Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
100% chance of obtaining 1-3 bronze medals

-Can be obtained through looting goblins, the goblin king, or in supply drops.
- Can be used to convert medals and exchange items:
  10 bronze medals to 1 silver medal;
  12 silver medals to 1 gold medal;
  1 gold medal to 8 silver medals;
  1 silver medal to 6 bronze medals.
Sports Uniform (Male/Female)
- Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with silver medals:
Head/Hands: 2 silver medals
Top: 6 silver medals
Bottom/Shoes: 5 silver medals
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8977ed14d10767040d01ca47e5811b40e54ef130.jpg"]Synthetic race tracks

notes.title: PixARK 1.214 Patch Note
notes.notes:
BUG Fixes:
Fixed a issue where allowed summoning Artikel anywhere in Skypiea map.

Fixed a issue where Artikel’s X-button skill had no cooldown.
After the fix, the cooldown time is set to 60 seconds.

Adjusted the stamina consumption of Artikel’s right-click skill:
Using the right-click skill in any form now consumes 150 stamina points.

Fixed a display bug in Artikel’s dex entry.

Players below level 60 have a chance to be forcefully dismounted while riding Artikel.

notes.title: PixARK 1.213 7th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Dear Explorers,
The moment has come.
To celebrate seven years of exploration, creation, and survival—we’re ushering in a powerful new force from the depths of the elemental wilds: Artikel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e0143dce600ac9a5a4f3c663c928d86c5941636b.jpg

Now roaming the lands of PixARK, Artikel is no ordinary beast. Born from the resonance of elemental energy, it is a creature of mystery and might—waiting for a worthy tamer to uncover its potential.
Will you earn its trust?
Will you master its elemental forms?
Or will you fall before the storm it brings?
The journey continues, and Artikel awaits.
Thank you for seven incredible years. Here's to the adventures still ahead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/15fa7cf2dad99ebf75922b473f70fd12cf7c51e2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d4bca032edceffcc73c0ad2575d4fe3a8ff91064.jpg

Taming Method
Craft an “Artikel Bait” and place it in a mine or Pit area to lure out a wild Artikel.
Once it appears, knock it out and tame it.

Specific spawn locations are as follows
Pixark：
●	Magical Mine
●	Plateau Magic Pit
●	Plateau Iron Pit
●	Brenstone Mine
●	Plateau Iron Mine
●	Quartz Pit
●	Silver Pit
Skyward：
●	Twilight Woods Mine
●	Mystical Valley Mine
●	Glittering Ridge Mine
●	Crystal Island Mine
●	Blackrock Mountain Mine	

Skills
Left Click: Basic Attack
Right Click: Elemental Skill Attack
(7 elemental states, each with a unique effect)
C Key: Toggle between Biped and Quadruped stance
X Key: Prism Veil
(During the Prism Veil buff, up to 10 hits can be blocked. Each block consumes one Magic Essence of any type.)

Right Click Skills by Element
Fire / Red:
Breathes fire forward, dealing damage and applying a burn effect.
Water / Blue:
Fires a stream of water forward, dealing damage and slowing the target.
Wind / Green:
Releases several small tornados forward, causing knockback.
Earth / Yellow:
Launches multiple rocks forward, dealing damage and applying a defense-breaking effect.
Lightning / Purple:
Fires a lightning beam forward that reduces the target’s armor effectiveness.
Light / White:
Shoots multiple radiant projectiles forward, dealing damage and causing blindness.
Dark / Gray:
Fires a death siphon beam forward, dealing damage while partially restoring Artikel’s HP.

Special Abilities
1.Approach and hold E to open the radial menu, then select “Change Body Color” to switch elemental states.
Each change consumes one Magic Essence of the corresponding color.

2.Each elemental state grants a passive bonus:
Fire / Red: Increases attack power
Water / Blue: Increases swimming speed and health regeneration
Wind / Green: Increases movement speed
Earth / Yellow: Reduces incoming damage
Lightning / Purple: Creates a static field that paralyzes nearby enemies
Light / White: Emits light
Dark / Gray: Grants invisibility to the rider

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c6a9e3bd76025336bf82f21164b6f2a5e7bc0b8d.gif

Steam 1.207 Lunar New Year Patch Notes

New Items：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9503ff5726efb6e8a6420e812b44d55246773b84.gif

Boss Challenge：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bfd70a23c1996cf9048d67408ac0b654f6f2b972.jpg

Great Nian Beast

The Great Nian Beast is a special kind of Nian beast that only appears during the Chinese New Year. It is much larger and stronger than the ordinary Nian beasts, and has the ability to weaken opponents with fear, ignite, slow and exhaust. It will also buff itself with "Inferno"and "Eternal Night" upon taking damage. However, such a powerful creature is only afraid of the traditional Chinese dragon lantern. Explorers can negate most of the debuff by carrying the dragon lantern to challenge it, and you will also deal increased damage and receive decreased damage.

Skills：
1、Swipe： Regular attack
2、Heavy Slam: Slams the ground with its paws, knocking back enemies. 
3、Soul of the Nian Beast: Releases Soul of the NIan Beast to attack the enemies in front, dealing “fear” debuff along the way. (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)
4、Dance of Blessing: A special kind of dance among the Nian Beasts, which will buff itself with “Force of the Nian,” increasing its damage while taking less damage. It will reflect a portion of the melee damage taken to the attacker. Dragon Tail Lantern can eliminate this buff.
5、Flamethrower: Deals damage and applies an ignite DOT. The ignite DOT can spread among enemies during the “Force of the Nian” buff. (Immune to Dragon Tail Lantern and players carrying dragon tail lantern)
6、Outrage: Slams enemy multiple times and roars at the very end. Each slam deals damage, and slows enemy if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff. The roar decreases enemy attack damage, and decreases enemy defense if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff.   (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)

Boss will buff itself with “Inferno” during the second phase, which will increase its damage.
Boss will buff itself with “Eternal Night” during the third phase, which will increase its damage while taking less damage. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2bf8f91ded63ba48be137039c59cf618f2b30ad6.gif


 It is not easy to challenge the Great Nian Beast, but it is  afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance."
 Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
 Players can initiate the Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg
Rules:

 Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
 Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
 The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.

Challenge Requirements:

 At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
 Challenge can be done once per day.
 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.

Loots: 

 Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
 Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
 50-100 Red Packets
 Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.
 Daeodon Food Recipe (can increase the effectiveness of the healing ability, and lower food consumption, doesn't work in boss arena)
 Red Snake Helmet at 100% chance.

notes.notes:
Luminara

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/878f402b79b80bac8701c562a83e30414595360e.jpg

The Luminara is a mythical flying creature believed to have been created by the Cobaltans. It is thought to have evolved from a powerful prototype creature exposed to intense cobalt radiation, resulting in its current form. Luminara possesses unparalleled control over radiation, enabling it to switch seamlessly between two states: energy absorption and energy release.

●	Energy Release Mode: Focused on offense, Luminara can penetrate enemy armor and inflict massive damage.
●	Energy Absorption Mode: Prioritizes defense and recovery, granting damage reduction and the ability to heal itself during combat.

Key Abilities:
●	Immortality and Rebirth:
A tamed Luminara demonstrates an almost immortal ability. Upon death, it leaves behind a Resurrection Egg. Using specific materials, this egg can be reactivated to resurrect the Luminara.

Taming:
To tame a wild Luminara, provoke it into using its Energy Beam ability, which depletes its radiation energy and has a 20-second cooldown. Keep in mind that if the Luminara doesn’t fire another Energy Beam within 30 seconds, its radiation energy will fully recharge. Once you’ve completely drained its radiation energy, the Luminara will enter a Frenzy state. At this moment, defeat it to obtain a fertilized egg. Incubate the egg under the right conditions to hatch a tamed Luminara.

Hatching:
In addition to meeting temperature requirements, radiation levels must also be sufficient to hatch a fertilized Luminara egg.

Death and Revival:
When a tamed Luminara is killed, it transforms into a Resurrection Egg. By consuming specific materials in the Conjuring Cooking Pot (crafted from Magic Workbench), the Luminara can be resurrected.

Controls and Abilities:
●	Left Click: Basic Attack
●	Right Click:
1.	Energy Beam (Release Mode): Deals damage that penetrates armor.
2.	Energy Drain (Absorption Mode): Inflicts damage while healing itself based on a percentage of the damage dealt.
●	C Key:
1.	Radiation Energy Field (Release Mode): Creates an energy field that boosts the damage and speed of cobalt variant creautres and cobaltstar creatures within its range. (Consumes Void Energy)
2.	Radiation Absorption Field (Absorption Mode): Generates an energy field that grants damage reduction and healing to cobalt variant creautres and cobaltstar creatures within its range. (Consumes Void Energy)
●	X Key: Mode Toggle. Switches Luminara between Release Mode and Absorption Mode (can only be used while on the ground).
●	Hold E: Activate Radiation Mode. In this mode, Luminara emits radiation energy in its surroundings, converting crop seeds in its inventory (carrots, lemons, wheat, corn, potatoes, mushrooms) into irradiated seeds with double yield. (Consumes Void Energy continuously)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ec07707d6ea29838218a1665459695007bda5d36.gif

In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. notes.title: Pixark Patch 1.198 Summer's Day
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24cee6d262355c0517d03e52f58caab05d2ac91c.jpg

As the sun blazes high and the days grow longer, we’re excited to bring back our summer events!  This update is all about embracing the joys of summer with a wave of exciting new content, sizzling adventures, and refreshing changes that will make your gaming experience even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into the highlights of this sun-soaked update!

New Creature：Ice Demon Scorpion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/deb885a798cbd16833a04bd5659ca7e77f83c014.png
The Ice Demon corpion is a scorpion-like magical beast that dwells in extremely cold regions. Despite its small size, it possesses formidable strength. Its large pincers serve as both powerful weapons for attacking and shields for defending against frontal assaults. The most threatening aspect of the Ice Demon Scorpion is its tail, which can shoot icicle needles.
This creature is imbued with a significant amount of ice element, causing those who approach it to feel an intense chill. Riders must take precautions to stay warm while riding the Ice Demon Scorpion.
One notable weakness of the Ice Demon Scorpion is its inability to move while firing icicle needles. Clever fighters often exploit this flaw to defeat the otherwise mighty creature in battle.

Skills
LMB：Regular attack. In turret mode, the attack transforms into icicle needle attacks, consuming ice magic stone essence which can be obtained by combining ice and water magic stone within Ice Demon Scorpion’s inventory.
RMB：Toggle into turret mode where regular attacks will transform into icicle needle attacks.
C Button：Adds an ice claw buff where all damages taken by the claws are reduced by half. Regular attacks will have a chance to slow the enemies.

Special Abilities
1. Increase heat resistance to all players nearby, while reducing the cold resistance.
2. Consumables such as food  in the inventory spoil slower

Spawn Locations：
Pixark：Frozen Land
Skyward：Crystal Island

Change in Reindeer spawn locations：
Pixark：Mountian Forest
Skyward：Woodlands 

Holiday Dodo is BACK!
Players can obtain Casual Beachwear/Crab Beachwear/Beach Lounger upon defeating Holiday Dodos at:

Pixark：Novice Grassland/Grassland
Skyward：Dawn Island/Woodland

New Items
1. New potion “Great Beast Serum” :

Introducing the Great Beast Serum in ARK defending challenge mode. It is  a potent concoction extracted from the blood of various creatures. This mixed serum can significantly enhance the strength and abilities of dinosaurs, making them even more formidable in battle.

Players can craft it at the ARK tower in the defending challenge with: 
- Dilophosaurus Venom x5
- Mantis Shell x5
- Argentavis Feather x1
- Rex Skull x1
- Werewolf blood x1

BUFF：Using this serum increases the attack power and damage resistance of all tamed dinosaurs near the player by 50%. The effect lasts for 120 minutes. However, this serum can only be used in the ARK Defending Challenge. Upon leaving the Ark Tower, both the serum and its buff will be removed. Each player can craft only one bottle of this serum every 24 hours.

2. Ice Demon  Scorpion Saddle - can be learned at lv70.

Event Changes:

 Closing Children’s Day event. 


Optimization
1. Fixed a UI display issue with multiple monitors.

BUG Fixes

We really appreciate all of the participation we have received on the Community Creature Contest so far! Keep up the great suggestions. You have a full month from the announcement posting date, which hopefully gives you plenty of time to brainstorm and share your best community creature creations.

notes.notes:
Steam 1.191 Lunar New Year Patch Notes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e2f6a1bb309b893e37e33f9ccc6d30150aa35de6.jpg

Every performance is a canvas where performers, adorned in elaborate costumes, embody the essence of their characters and deliver an aesthetic show. Build your unique stage with your friends, watch it come true, and let it take over you!

The content below can be crafted at the “Traditional Opera Style Shop,” which can be learned with lv9 primitive skill after purchasing the DLC. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9434189b7cb32621436f1f2a802545b9ec197b8b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ff098532b753614873d6dff28402fe9a8d131e64.jpg

New Boss：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bfd70a23c1996cf9048d67408ac0b654f6f2b972.jpg

Great Nian Beast

The Great Nian Beast is a special kind of Nian beast that only appears during the Chinese New Year. It is much larger and stronger than the ordinary Nian beasts, and has the ability to weaken opponents with fear, ignite, slow and exhaust. It will also buff itself with "Inferno"and "Eternal Night" upon taking damage. However, such a powerful creature is only afraid of the traditional Chinese dragon lantern. Explorers can negate most of the debuff by carrying the dragon lantern to challenge it, and you will also deal increased damage and receive decreased damage.

Skills：
1、Swipe： Regular attack
2、Heavy Slam: Slams the ground with its paws, knocking back enemies. 
3、Soul of the Nian Beast: Releases Soul of the NIan Beast to attack the enemies in front, dealing “fear” debuff along the way. (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)
4、Dance of Blessing: A special kind of dance among the Nian Beasts, which will buff itself with “Force of the Nian,” increasing its damage while taking less damage. It will reflect a portion of the melee damage taken to the attacker. Dragon Tail Lantern can eliminate this buff.
5、Flamethrower: Deals damage and applies an ignite DOT. The ignite DOT can spread among enemies during the “Force of the Nian” buff. (Immune to Dragon Tail Lantern and players carrying dragon tail lantern)
6、Outrage: Slams enemy multiple times and roars at the very end. Each slam deals damage, and slows enemy if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff. The roar decreases enemy attack damage, and decreases enemy defense if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff.   (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)

Boss will buff itself with “Inferno” during the second phase, which will increase its damage.
Boss will buff itself with “Eternal Night” during the third phase, which will increase its damage while taking less damage. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2bf8f91ded63ba48be137039c59cf618f2b30ad6.gif


 It is not easy to challenge the Great Nian Beast, but it is  afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance."
 Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
 Players can initiate the Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg
Rules:

 Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
 Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
 The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.

Challenge Requirements:

 At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
 Challenge can be done once per day.
 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.

Loots: 

 Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
 Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
 50-100 Red Packets
 Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.
 Daeodon Food Recipe (can increase the effectiveness of the healing ability, and lower food consumption, doesn't work in boss arena)


Old Items ARE BACK!

Head：300 Red Packets

How to get puzzle pieces

Pieces 1 to 10:Participate in snowball fights, mining Christmas snow blocks, and killing creatures wearing Christmas hats.
Pieces 11 to 13:Search airdrop supply boxes.

Snowball:

Blizzard:
Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
Snow Pillar:
Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
One-Punch Devil:
Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.

notes.title: Steam 1.185 Halloween Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Explorers！ 
We are bringing you our Halloween Patch! Happy Halloween! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/543c9189983e769e1e4466d6d17d9488fc41600c.jpg
New Creatures:

Carcharodontosaurus 
The Carcharodontosaurus lived in North Africa during the Cretaceous period and earned its name due to its tooth shape resembling that of a shark. This species was a massive and fierce predator, possibly even more formidable than the larger Spinosaurus that coexisted in the same region. In the world of Pixark, the Carcharodontosaurus is considered a top-tier predator that rivals the Giganotosaurus in power. It shares a massive size and a more aggressive nature, especially when it enters the special "Bloodlust" state. It is easier to control compared to the Giganotosaurus. However, it is less powerful than the Giganotosaurus in terms of stats, and it cannot enter most challenges. To date, no wild Carcharodontosaurus has been discovered in the world of Pixark; all known domesticated Carcharodontosaurus are hatched from eggs obtained by challenging the Mega Carcharodontosaurus.

Its eggs can be obtained by challenge the new BOSS Mega Carcharodontosaurus.

New BOSS:
Mega Carcharodontosaurus 
A colossal and likely genetically modified or enhanced dinosaur, the Mega Carcharodontosaurus is significantly more potent than its regular counterpart. It possesses a more aggressive temperament, and anyone attempting to challenge it must be well-prepared, as the Mega Carcharodontosaurus is one of the most dangerous creatures in Pixark. Defeating it will drop a fertilized Mega Carcharodontosaurus egg with random levels.

Ability 1: Normal Attack, inflicting a "Shredded" state on enemies for 9 seconds (reduces HP regen and stamina).
Ability 2: Tail swing,  inflicting a knockback effect.
Ability 3: War Cry, activated in the second phase. The Mega Carcharodontosaurus lets out a roar that induces "Fear" in nearby dinosaurs and starts accumulating the "Bloodlust" state over the next 30 seconds. For every 20,000 damage dealt, it gains 1 point of "Bloodlust" and also receives a 10-second "Rampage" effect. Each point of "Bloodlust" increases its attack by 5%, and HP regen by 1 per second. When the "Bloodlust" reaches the maximum, it will deal x1.5 damage and an HP regen of 10 points per second. "Rampage" grants the Mega Carcharodontosaurus approximately a 20% increase in movement speed and enhanced stun resistance.

Can be challenge at Ancient Wyvern King Challenge Gate.

New Creatures:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d86875553cd6cd2674b60c2d535e1973b5d23f95.jpg
Yutyrannus
The Yutyrannus is a large carnivorous dinosaur that lived in ancient China during the Cretaceous period. It was one of the largest predators in the region and was well-adapted to cold environments with its feathers. In the world of Pixark, its long feathers covering its head and neck make it very majestic and stand out. Besides its formidable strength, its unique roar plays a significant role in battles.

Spawn biomes: Frozen Land, Crystal Island

Prairie Dog
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/17d6b0d80071be9b186cbc3376f44b25e48cbc3b.jpg
The prairie dog is a highly social, burrowing rodent known for its stout and slow-moving build. Despite being physically small and vulnerable to numerous natural predators, prairie dogs exhibit a high level of alertness. When they live in colonies, they often designate sentinels to stand guard and alert the group to potential threats. In the world of Pixark, prairie dogs still occupy a low position in the food chain. However, they serve a valuable role when tamed by humans. Tamed prairie dogs can help alert players to nearby threats, including dangerous creatures or other rival players, by using different alert sounds. Additionally, some players enjoy keeping prairie dogs as pets on their heads whose loud warning sounds can temporarily scare away any approaching enemy. 

Spawn biomes: Woodland, Grassland

Old Creatures Come Back!
Skeleton Horse

It is a skeleton war horse burning with the flames of hell. Legend has it that the skeleton horse is the mount of the knight of hell, and is the most reliable partner of the knight. It can fly to the sky and dive into the sea like walking on the ground, and the energy from hell also gives it the power of eternal life.

Left click -  Normal attack

Right click- Sacrifice: unleashes the flames of hell to inflict continuous damage to enemies within a certain range (damage value correlates to the HP of the  enemy, while damage upper limit correlates to the percentage of melee damage of the skeleton horse)

'C' button - path of flame, activates its own hell energy, increases its own movement speed  by 50% and melee damage by 30%. Moving will leave a hell flame in place, enemies near the hell flame will take continuous damage (1-50 dmg/0.5 sec)

Fire creatures are immune to the above skills

Magical Crystal Berry: The food favored by skeleton horses that replenish their hell energy.  It can be crafted at magic workbench with a dark Magic Stone and a magic berry. 

Where to find it? 

 Skeleton Horse (permanent) can be summoned at “Conjuring Cooking Pot” at 70% chance with:

  1x Breath Of the Dead
  1x Pegasus DNA
  2x Felhunter DNAs
  5x Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper

 Upon failing, you will get a tamed Pegasus or a Felhunter.
 Defeating following monsters/BOSS will drop the corresponding items:

 Pegasus: Pegasus DNA at 20% chance, 
 Pumpkin Soul Reaper:  Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at 20% chance
 Felhunter:  Felhunter DNA at 20% chance 
 Death Lord (Boss)/ Bone Wyvern King (Boss): Breath of the Dead at 100% chance.
Note：
[olist]
 “Conjuring Cooking Pot” can be crafted at magic workbench. 
 Breath of the Dead can be exchanged with 40  Scents of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at the Conjuring Cooking Pot.  
[/olist]

Skeleton horse is endowed with strong vitality. Like any other bone creatures, it can resurrect as well.  It can be resurrected at the Conjuring Cooking Pot with 50 Magic Stone of any of the following types: Dark, Fire, Water, Thunder, Light, Earth, and Wind

Skeleton Horse Saddle:
Can be exchanged at tailor’s workbench with pumpkins. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/267ca412d493495947fac766e301e3098b982d54.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a882752200f6fd9110632a9e312d9d69306c7704.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e02c3890d3a4c72b4df0e2ee0b5c0233c98f6bb7.gif

THEY ARE BACK!!
Upon the arrival of Halloween, so do all those naughty Pumpkin Soul Reapers out there trick or treating. Hurry up and fight them off! 

During the event, Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in:
Pixark: Novice Grassland, Grassland
Skyward: Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void

Defeating it will drop:
Scent of the Pumpkin
Pumpkin Seed
Magic Broom (7 days)

New Boss：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bfd70a23c1996cf9048d67408ac0b654f6f2b972.jpg

Great Nian Beast

The Great Nian Beast is a special kind of Nian beast that only appears during the Chinese New Year. It is much larger and stronger than the ordinary Nian beasts, and has the ability to weaken opponents with fear, ignite, slow and exhaust. It will also buff itself with "Inferno"and "Eternal Night" upon taking damage. However, such a powerful creature is only afraid of the traditional Chinese dragon lantern. Explorers can negate most of the debuff by carrying the dragon lantern to challenge it, and you will also deal increased damage and receive decreased damage.

Skills：
1、Swipe： Regular attack
2、Heavy Slam: Slams the ground with its paws, knocking back enemies. 
3、Soul of the Nian Beast: Releases Soul of the NIan Beast to attack the enemies in front, dealing “fear” debuff along the way. (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)
4、Dance of Blessing: A special kind of dance among the Nian Beasts, which will buff itself with “Force of the Nian,” increasing its damage while taking less damage. It will reflect a portion of the melee damage taken to the attacker. Dragon Tail Lantern can eliminate this buff.
5、Flamethrower: Deals damage and applies an ignite DOT. The ignite DOT can spread among enemies during the “Force of the Nian” buff. (Immune to Dragon Tail Lantern and players carrying dragon tail lantern)
6、Outrage: Slams enemy multiple times and roars at the very end. Each slam deals damage, and slows enemy if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff. The roar decreases enemy attack damage, and decreases enemy defense if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff.   (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)

Boss will buff itself with “Inferno” during the second phase, which will increase its damage.
Boss will buff itself with “Eternal Night” during the third phase, which will increase its damage while taking less damage. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2bf8f91ded63ba48be137039c59cf618f2b30ad6.gif


 It is not easy to challenge the Great Nian Beast, but it is  afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance."
 Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
 Players can initiate the Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg
Rules:

 Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
 Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
 The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.

Challenge Requirements:

 At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
 Challenge can be done once per day.
 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.

notes.title: 《Wonder In Water》Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/eec3f066e67bde1893cf27cf6f741c9e3f48c087.jpg

Dear Explorers,

In this patch, we bring you a brand new building experience as well as a new challenge defending ARK against Cobalt aliens.


New Underwater Structures
By learning Cobalt technology, you will master the art of building underwater. Take a look at the new structures and build your favorite underwater base!

Vacuum Compartment
Vacuum compartment is a cubical frame with a side length of 6 meters. It needs to be placed underwater and powered with a TEK generator preferably. It is a sealed compartment that drains the space while filling it with air, allowing the player to breathe and place structures in it. You can expand the frame by removing the sides to attach another structure. Note that if the removed surface is exposed to water, the water will fill the entire compartment. Each surface can also be locked by holding E. Once locked, the surface cannot be removed until unlocking it, preventing the player from accidentally removing a surface that is in contact with water.

Vacuum Compartment Moonpool
It functions exactly like a normal Vacuum compartment but has a hatch on its downside for entrance.

Both blueprints can be obtained from the ARK Defend Challenge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8777d2d8eb445c4829e3fc9832c138261450a07c.jpg

ARK Defend Challenge

Players can now participate in ARK Defend through an ARK Defending Portal. 

Life has become calm and peaceful on Skyward, but it seems it won’t be for long! A newly hatched dino broke out of its shell, causing a purple light to tear through the night sky, opening up a rift. Countless cosmic rays pour through the rift and brutally tear the ARK shields apart. The energy of the ARK is scattered and collected by the Cobalt Aliens on their spaceship as it glows brighter! The planet survived under the blessing of the ARK, however, the Cobalt Aliens are starting to manipulate creatures to attack the ARK once again.  Darkness has fallen and hope has faded. However, in the depths of despair, we’ve found the heart to grow stronger. Get ready and defend against the Cobalt Alien attacks once more, for the dawn will eventually come.

The Ark will reward players for their courage and victory. Collecting all the energy in the following places will reward you different set of equipment:
            -Magic Island : Royal Knight Set
            -Ice and Fire Island: Royal Set
            -Cobalt Star Battlefield: War God Set

Additional rewards include chance of:
            - Goblin Wonder Cabin exchange coupons
            -  Tek energy cubes
            - Vacuum compartment blueprint  
             - Vacuum compartment moonpool blueprint 
             - Exclusive saddle 
             - Giganotosaurus skin 
             - Equipment Modification Core 
             - Equipment Elemental crystal

Collecting all the energy has a chance to drop new structures and a permanent summoning scroll of a rare creature. The Goblin Wonder Cabin will allow you to try your luck using their exchange coupons. The Werewolf Sculpture will add a nice touch to your buildings! The Cobalt Star Turret will provide the best protection for your base!

Clear the Cobalt Star Battlefield to truly shatter the Cobalt Aliens' malevolence. You will be rewarded with a chance to win a permanent summoning scroll for the rare BOSS creature Cobalt Energy Golem Hammer!


There will be a total of three difficulties:
-	Beginner: Magic Island
-	Expert: Ice and Fire Island
-	Master: Cobalt Star Battlefield

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/208eb489e4bfd165ddada81045ee2b75645bfe84.jpg

How to Participate： 
You can start the challenge by placing items at the ARK Defending Portal if you meet all the requirements. A corresponding portal will open after the countdown, which will teleport all players and their creatures from the same tribe into the challenge. Players  will have 90 mins to clear.

Rules：

1.	ARK Defending Portal may be crafted at Exquisite Architectural Hut.
2.	ARK Defending Portal may be placed at any spot on the map.
3.	ARK Defending Portal requires resources to activate the challenge. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0b64071d084822388181a7d1c3913791e2804bd2.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/11e604cc08edabd03b364f790113e62d2979e3e9.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7c29d49d3cbff071e9196e06ef018224af9f9c4b.jpg

4.	The 90 mins countdown begins once every player has teleported.
5.    Manipulated creatures will attack the ARK in the challenge. Defeating them will automatically collect energy, which will be displayed as a score. 
6. There will be a total of 50 waves of creatures, with each wave 90 seconds apart. 
                    - Upon defeating an entire wave, the next wave will spawn in 10 seconds. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bb89466404c09da1c6ec669938e54be3ee2dbcfd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d82c3c261989ac7f6692104bd52a264c546fe4d5.jpg


7. There will be buffs and debuffs spawning across the map. Both you and your enemy can benefit from these. 
8. Defeating elites and Bosses will have a chance to obtain Defending Coin, which can be used to exchange magical plants/potions at the ARK to assist your battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5795e714104c8e87a1fff84a6ad33757582f5cdb.jpg

 -  Magical Plant can slow the attacks from the opponent. The higher its level, the longer it persists. More Defending Coins are required for higher levels.

-	Magic Potion can increase HP, attack, defense, and stamina once consumed. The higher its level, the more powerful it will be. More Defending Coins are required for higher levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9b6de87eb965f873499fc2678c4a18428223d636.jpg

Challenge Termination/Failure：
1.	You can terminate the challenge anytime at the ARK. You will have 10 minutes to pick up any loot.
2.	Your challenge will fail if the ARK HP reaches 0, and you will have 10 minutes to pick up any loot,
3.	If all players are defeated in the challenge, they will be teleported out and can gather their rewards at the ARK Defending Portal.
 

You will be able to clear the challenge and collect your loot if you：
1.	Clear all waves in 90 mins.
2.	Defeat all creatures in every wave，

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/76ef340789c44ad725ef910864c5fe233cbd0cee.jpg
Snow Devil is Back!
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

Skills:
Snowball:
Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
Blizzard:
Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
Snow Pillar:
Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
One-Punch Devil:
Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.

Special Abilities:
Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer the player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed and cold resistance to enemies who touch it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cd318331f04dbd9d1006278b9ca8356d2bfec43d.gif

Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards.

notes.notes:
Dear Explorers！ 
We are bringing you our Halloween Patch! Happy Halloween! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5af13278f3a65552c0d2e4e14b483695a1b1a727.png

A Fantastic Beast and Where to Find It
Skeleton Horse

It is a skeleton war horse burning with the flames of hell. Legend has it that the skeleton horse is the mount of the knight of hell, and is the most reliable partner of the knight. It can fly to the sky and dive into the sea like walking on the ground, and the energy from hell also gives it the power of eternal life.

Left click -  Normal attack

Right click- Sacrifice: unleashes the flames of hell to inflict continuous damage to enemies within a certain range (damage value correlates to the HP of the  enemy, while damage upper limit correlates to the percentage of melee damage of the skeleton horse)

'C' button - path of flame, activates its own hell energy, increases its own movement speed  by 50% and melee damage by 30%. Moving will leave a hell flame in place, enemies near the hell flame will take continuous damage (1-50 dmg/0.5 sec)

Fire creatures are immune to the above skills

Magical Crystal Berry: The food favored by skeleton horses that replenish their hell energy.  It can be crafted at magic workbench with a dark Magic Stone and a magic berry. 

Where to find it? 

 Skeleton Horse (permanent) can be summoned at “Conjuring Cooking Pot” at 70% chance with:

  1x Breath Of the Dead
  1x Pegasus DNA
  2x Felhunter DNAs
  5x Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper

 Upon failing, you will get a tamed Pegasus or a Felhunter.
 Defeating following monsters/BOSS will drop the corresponding items:

 Pegasus: Pegasus DNA at 20% chance, 
 Pumpkin Soul Reaper:  Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at 20% chance
 Felhunter:  Felhunter DNA at 20% chance 
 Death Lord (Boss)/ Bone Wyvern King (Boss): Breath of the Dead at 100% chance.
Note：
[olist]
 “Conjuring Cooking Pot” can be crafted at magic workbench. 
 Breath of the Dead can be exchanged with 40  Scents of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at the Conjuring Cooking Pot.  
[/olist]

Skeleton horse is endowed with strong vitality. Like any other bone creatures, it can resurrect as well.  It can be resurrected at the Conjuring Cooking Pot with 50 Magic Stone of any of the following types: Dark, Fire, Water, Thunder, Light, Earth, and Wind

Can be exchanged at tailor’s workbench with pumpkins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24cee6d262355c0517d03e52f58caab05d2ac91c.jpg
New BOSS——Mega Giganotosaurus
The Giganotosaurus is one of the creatures standing at the top of the food chain. With its gigantic body size, aggressive temper. and powerful attack, the actual combat power will worth the time you invest in. However, the Giganotosaurus has two major drawbacks that cannot be ignored. First, Giganotosaurus is highly impulsive and irritable, and once provoked, it will attack all creatures around indiscriminately. The other drawback is due to its huge size, which does not allow it to challenge elite creatures/BOSS in most challenges. 

Skills:

 Crunch: While in rage mode during Phase 2/3, its attack will deal an addtional 2%/5% max HP to enemies. 
 Roar: enemies around it will be confused and uncontrollable.
 Berserk: its attack will increase upon taking damage.


Drops：

 One fertilized Giganotosaurus egg (100% chance) 
 Tek Storage Box blueprint
 Sauce Meat blueprint


Challenge：

 Players will need to summon the “Ancient Gate” and use energy stone to teleport and challenge the Mega Giganotosaurus. 
 Ancient gate recipe can be learned at lv90 and crafted at the Inscription Book
 Energy stone recipe can be learned at lv90 and crafted at the Alchemy Stove
 Only one challenge can be started at each Ancient Gate with a  cooldown time of 24 hours.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/da420bd57d97a3f684a7b054f3649d221d80edb4.jpg   
 New Creature
Giganotosaurus
The Giganotosaurus once lived in Argentina, South America, during the Cretaceous period. With its huge body size, powerful and agile bite. and as sharp as a steel knife teeth, the actual combat power may be comparable to Tyrannosaurus rex. In Pixark, the Giganotosaurus is one of the creatures standing at the top of the food chain with a super aggressive power that far surpasses the ordinary Tyrannosaurus Rex. The Giganotosaurus is impulsive and irritable, and once enraged, it will attack all creatures around it indiscriminately, even friendly ones. So far, no wild Giganotosaurus has been found in the land of Pixark. All known domesticated Giganotosaurus are hatched from eggs obtained by challenging the Mega Giganotosaurus.


LMB：Regular attack
RMB：Roar（No actual effect）
Passive：Giganotosaurus will enter the "berserk" state when its rage bar reaches 100%. In addition, upon taking a single hit with a damage of 25% of its maximum HP, it will instantly enter the "berserk" state. The "berserk" state will enrage all giganotosaurus within a certain range for 20 seconds, attacking all creatures and players.  When the rage bar has not reached 100%,  each 1% rage increase will increase the maximum damage by 1%. After entering the "berserk" state, the rage bar returns to zero.


Spinosaurus
Spinosaurus was an aquatic or semi-aquatic dinosaur that lived in the Cretaceous period. With a huge body size but a slender mouth, its actual combat power is far less than a Tyrannosaurus rex. However, it might not be the case in Pixark, and certainly not if it is in water. Spinosaurus can travel effortlessly in water, and is the nemesis of all aquatic creatures.

LMB：Regular attack
RMB：Switch between moving in 2&4 feet. 
C button：A roar that can confuse all surrounding creatures in water.
Passive：Enters a “humid” state when in water, increasing its attack by 15%, movement speed by 20%, and takes 20% less damage. The humid state will wear off upon leaving water for 30 seconds. 

Spawn：
Pixark：Frozen Land
Skyward：Crystal Island

Mechanical Tiger

A huge, heavily armored mechanical tiger with a powerful electric charge attack. Perhaps its sudden appearance is again related to the Cobalt aliens. (Dragon Lantern and players carrying Dragon Lantern can significantly weaken the boss when it uses Furious Roar.)

 It is not easy to challenge the great Mechanical Tiger, but they are afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance"
 Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
 Players can initiate the Bull Demon Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg
Rules:

 Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
 Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
 The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.

Challenge Requirements:

 At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
 Challenge can be done once per day.
 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.

 Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.

New Boss：
Yeti
Bigby and Tinnie are the Yeti brothers who live in the land of the sheer cold. The older brother Bigby is stout and hasty while the little brother is timid, careful and stays on Bigby’s back all day. Their personalities complement each other and they know each other too well. Challenging  them will be a tough battle.

 Fury Swipe: Deals damage to enemies hit.

Pixark 1.149 Christmas Patch Notes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/76ef340789c44ad725ef910864c5fe233cbd0cee.jpg
Snow Devil is Back!
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

Skills:
Snowball:
Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
Blizzard:
Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
Snow Pillar:
Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
One-Punch Devil:
Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.

Special Abilities:
Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer the player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed and cold resistance to enemies who touch it.

Steam Pixark 1.145 Thanksgiving Patch Notes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/003ff92c0583aa572892a88dd8a9da5de667dbca.jpg

Thanksgiving Gameplay 

Thanksgiving Banquet
Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

Pardoned Turkey Event
In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. 
While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 30% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey. Killing the Pardoned Turkey will drop the event item “Turkey Feather,” which can be used to summon Dodorex.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef1f35f83c40a8167bcefc768cde45ac55064029.jpg
Turkey Challenge - Summoning Dodorex

 Upon collecting a certain amount of Turkey Feathers, explorers can use them to summon either a Dodorex (20 mins at 90% chance) or a Dodorex (Permanent at 10% chance) at a cooking pot.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ad2a513442da8aa5d7dced861e18d78dd74e7d33.gif

Dodorex
In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. Legend has it that some dodos with exceptional talent were blessed by the ancestors of the dodo family and evolved into the most powerful Dodorex. Of course the legend is just a legend, in fact, people believe that Dodorex may be the descendants of Tyrannosaurus rex genetically modified by aliens. The biggest basis for this idea is that people have not yet found evidence of the existence of wild Dodorex.

 Tamed Dodorex can bite (LMB) and shoot flames (RMB)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c88c0fba5deb52109bcb0714fbea803189851320.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5d5169b14791ea7318d9e9bb7c4f112e830d9ccb.jpg

notes.notes:
Dear Explorers！ 
We are bringing you our brand new Halloween Patch! Happy Halloween! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5af13278f3a65552c0d2e4e14b483695a1b1a727.png

New Gameplay: A Fantastic Beast and Where to Find It
Skeleton Horse

It is a skeleton war horse burning with the flames of hell. Legend has it that the skeleton horse is the mount of the knight of hell, and is the most reliable partner of the knight. It can fly to the sky and dive into the sea like walking on the ground, and the energy from hell also gives it the power of eternal life.

Left click -  Normal attack

Right click- Sacrifice: unleashes the flames of hell to inflict continuous damage to enemies within a certain range (damage value correlates to the HP of the  enemy, while damage upper limit correlates to the percentage of melee damage of the skeleton horse)

notes.title: Patch 1.118 - Lunar New Year 2021 Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74a9bbe02ebc6e3ae90b8a1af495e19f51686a15.jpg
Hey Explorers!

Lunar New Year is just around the corner! The Lunar New Year Patch is dropping tonight, 02/03 at 12:00 AM PT. It’s the Year of the Ox, and the Bull Demon King has long awaited for this moment to make his appearance in the world of PixARK. It is only around this time that daring Explorers may summon the Bull Demon King and battle him in a test of skill and bravery! Great rewards and great fortune await those powerful enough to defeat him!

The Lantern Dragon has made its way here for the Lunar New Year festivities as well! Players can obtain one by defeating the Bull Demon King, or build their very own by collecting pieces of the Dragon Lantern! Lantern Dragons come in many sizes - see if you and your friends can build a 5-seat Lantern Dragon for the ultimate ride! As a symbol of people’s aspirations for a better life in the new year, the Lantern Dragon and its pieces are also valuable against the nefarious  Bull Demon King!

What’s a celebration without glitz and glamor? A new Chainmail Set, Lance weapon, 8 additional structure colors are now available for all your Lunar New Year cosmetic needs! Returning are also some of last year’s Lunar New Year events! Don’t miss out on the Lunar New Year dishes - eat up for a full stomach and a variety of buffs!

Don’t forget to cash in on your Red Packets at the New Year Goblin Trading Center!

Community Features
The past year has been full of fun and festive Holiday events, and we're looking forward to more in 2021! We would be happy to see how players are celebrating and partaking in the fun - please upload or send us screenshots or videos of the Lunar New Year event to the Steam Community Hub or on on Twitter (be sure to tag @OfficialPixARK and/or use #playpixark) for a chance to be featured on our Official Twitter account here: https://twitter.com/OfficialPixARK

Happy Lunar Year from the PixARK Team!

Full Patch Notes and details on the Lunar New Year festivities are below:

New Creatures
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4c31bf89099ef1ca6ab42c98f3d2475a23fd7b26.jpg
New Challenge: Bull Demon King
In mythology, the Bull Demon King is so powerful that he is said to be able to travel between heaven and hell, move mountains, and calm storming seas. Even the Adepti cannot do anything about him. In the Pixark world, he is the King of Minotaurs, with strength exceeding far more than its kind. The Bull Demon King’s only weakness seems to be special creatures such as the resilient Dragon Lanterns. Damage dealt by the Bull Demon King to the Dragon Lantern’s Head/Body/Tail, and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail is significantly reduced.

The Bull Demon King is powerful, brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance" 
Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
Players can initiate the Bull Demon Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg
Rules:

 Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge. 
 Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
 The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.


Challenge Requirements:

 At least lv90 to initiate the challenge.
 Challenge can be done once per day.
 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge. 
 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge. 
 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge. 


Rewards:

 Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
 Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
 50-100 Red Packets
 Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.


Boss Skills:

 Max Strike: An axe strike from above, lowers the speed of enemies. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail will not be affected by the speed debuff)
 Pierce: Pierces enemies with the end of the axe, causes a bleeding effect. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail will not be affected by the bleed debuff)
 Whirlwind: Spinning attack that hits enemies within range, inflicts an armor reduction effect. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail  will not be affected by the armor reduction debuff)
 War Stomp: Stomping initiates a shockwave that lowers the melee attack of all enemies nearby. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail will not be affected by the debuff)
 Boshosen: Blows enemies and knocks them back. Also increases the debuff effects of Whirlwind and War Stomp
 War Cry: Raises its attack damage, defense and attack speed.  Applies additional effects on other skills:

 lowers Max Strike and Pierce cooldown
 Raises Whirlwind attack damage.
 Raises attack damage and range of the War Stomp
 Raises the range of Bashosen


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b6d779bc9fca3a66da03df8eb7032cca84ec25e6.gif

New Items:
New Year Goblin Trading Center 
Can be obtained from defeating goblins wearing God of Wealth hat or at event supply drops
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/42c8c7eb2e2615041396a1c3a9b03095567818b7.jpg

New Mount: Lantern Dragon
In China, lanterns are indispensable objects for festivals, and the flying Kong Ming lanterns are a symbol of people's aspiration for a better life. Now for the first time in Pixark, players can build their Lantern Dragon with lanterns and enjoy a ride with friends! 

Lantern Dragon can have up to 5 seats as you put more parts in!

New Boss:
Snow Devil
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

Skills:

 Snowball:Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
 Blizzard:Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance. 
 Snow Pillar:Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
 One-Punch Devil:Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.


Special Abilities

 Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
 Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed&cold resistance to enemies who touch it.

When could be a better time to show our sincere gratitude to explorers other than Thanksgiving! Thank you so much for your continuing support and love!

Thanksgiving Event Gameplay

Thanksgiving Banquet
Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

Pardoned Turkey Event
In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys, which will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 10% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey. Killing the Pardoned Turkey will drop the event item “Turkey Feather,” which can be used to summon Dodorex.

*Pardoned Turkeys have a relatively high HP, and will run away even if they are under attack.

New Creature

Dodorex
In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. Legend has it that some dodos with exceptional talent were blessed by the ancestors of the dodo family and evolved into the most powerful Dodorex. Of course the legend is just a legend, in fact, people believe that Dodorex may be the descendants of Tyrannosaurus rex genetically modified by aliens. The biggest basis for this idea is that people have not yet found evidence of the existence of wild Dodorex.

-Upon collecting a certain amount of Turkey Feathers, explorers can use them to summon either a Dodorex(Limited-time) or a Dodorex (Permanent) at a cooking pot.
 
-Tamed Dodorex can bite (LMB) and shoot flames (RMB)

notes.title: Update On the Server Closure
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ae10febdff384d93a954dbe110d677bcf0431cfd.jpg

Dear Explorers,

We first and foremost would like to express our deepest apologizes for the server shutdown, and the trouble it caused to our fellow explorers. We would then like to thank you for not only all the feedback you provided but also the time and effort that you have put into the game that we love. 

We will postpone our server closure, and focus on optimizing item/dino transfer experience for all explorers. Our goal is to save as much player data as possible so that players can have a smooth gameplay experience.

Additionally, we will push out a new tool in the near future where explorers could save an area of structures and transfer to another server altogether. Explorers could use this tool and create different strategies on PVE and PVP servers. 

We will also provide brand new servers for players to build/transfer on after the server closure.

We value every input and appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your understanding and continuing support!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/959839f1c3f6275781d01bd2c8e063567ed94309.png
Greeting Explorers!

We are excited to bring you our brand new St. Patrick’s Day patch! We hope you’ll have lots of fun as St. Patrick's Day approaches next week. :)

The patch is scheduled to go live tonight, Mar 13th, at 12:00, am Pacific Time. 

Servers will be down for a few hours to implement the following changes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f5b2a805975f73b46f745e9a9b77e9aed0728528.jpg
New Boss: Aurora Butterfly King A gigantic creature in the shape of a butterfly with aurora glowing from its wings. It will enter an “Aurora” phase in battle where its body will turn almost invisible. Explorers, look out for a fascinating beam of butterfly-shaped Aurora!

Skills:

 Normal attack: Uses its mouth to bite down enemies. 
 Aurora beam: Releases a beam of aurora from its mouth. The attack power is increased if it is in invisible mode.
 Butterfly Powder: The powder from its wings will deal poison damage over time to its enemies nearby, also lowering their attack powers. While in its shining mode, Butterfly powder will lower the attack and defense of its enemies nearby.
 (powder can be eliminated by the breath of fire from fire wyverns)
 String shot: Deals a small amount of damage while immobilizing enemies for a long period of time.
 (Wyverns cannot be immobilized)
 Butterfly Dance: Deals damage to enemies nearby and confuses them. Enemies will be unable to coordinate their movements for a short period of time.
 (Wyverns cannot be confused)
 Mirage: Creates a mirage of itself. Mirage will have  70% of its attack and 20% of its HP. 
 (Lightning/poison wyvern will deal triple damage to mirages)
 Aurora Mode: Turns itself, as well as its Mirages, to nearly invisible beams of aurora. Their attack damages will be lowered, but their defense will raise. Some skills are changed in Aurora mode as noted.


Dungeon:

 Players will need to summon the “Ancient Gate” to teleport and challenge the Aurora butterfly king.   
 Players will need to collect 7 types of magic stone (Dark/Water/Wind/Thunder/Fire/Light/Earth) and summon the “Ancient Gate” through the inscription book.
 Different sizes of the “Ancient Gate” can be summoned at different rates, which determines the amount of players/creatures that can go into the challenge. 
 Upon summoning,  “Ancient Gate” will be in inactivated mode. Players will need to obtain Energy Stone, which is craftable in the Alchemy Stove, to be placed on the Ancient Gate to activate the portal. If you wish to challenge the Aurora Butterfly King again, you will have to place another energy stone to activate the portal again.
 Upon activation, holding “E” button will allow you to choose which boss you would like to challenge. You can only challenge one boss per activation
 The cooldown for the boss fight will be 24 hours.


Rewards:
250 Tek energy cubes and one or two of the following items:

 - Ancient Gargoyle Skin (30% drop rate)
 - Magic Broom (permanent)  (30% drop rate)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/da010b5baf5dd73f8cf71f06f94f29ad6a8de9e4.jpg

Unlocked at lv35 under the “Industrial Skill” tab.
Greenhouse can raise plant growth rate by 300%
 Effective only for plants that can be planted in pots. 

Note: There cannot be structures above the greenhouse blocking the sunlight, otherwise the boosting effect will disappear.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/11df7b9f483c3d824d8b5cf980437adca8cd471b.jpg

Greetings, Explorers!

We hope you all had a wonderful year, and look forward to an even greater 2020! The next PixARK update is scheduled to go live at 12:00 am PDT on December 27th. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours.

Update: the patch is delayed to go live at 9:00 am PDT on December 27th. 

New Year Countdown
In celebration of the upcoming new year, we are adding a noticeable New Year Countdown Timer in the sky at the center of the map. From any biome in both the PixARK map or the Skyward map, when you look up, you can see the timer counting and when it reaches 2020/01/01 00: 00: 00 (server/local time), all explorers will be treated to a fireworks show NEARBY the timer! (Note: fireworks visuals won't be rendered if the players are too far away from the giant clock.)


New Items

 Countdown Clock: needs to be powered; players can input the time they want to count down from, and when it counts down to zero, the Trigger will send an activation signal to switch all the electricity-powered devices to “on”. The Countdown Clock engram can be unlocked at level 55, and craftable in the Fabricator.
 Fireworks Launcher: needs to be powered; players can place Fireworks Bullets inside its inventory, and turn on the switch to automatically shoot the fireworks in the sky; when aiming at the Fireworks Launcher, you can also hold E to select how high you want the fireworks to be fired. The Fireworks Launcher engram can be unlocked at level 55, and craftable in the Fabricator.


Fireworks Drops
Fireworks can be obtained at a higher drop rate from the Supply Beam which will also spawn at a higher rate. 

Bug Fixes
 
 Fixed an issue where the Cobaltenergy Golem did not show the correct required time for a mutation in the Radiation Mutation Platform. 


Be sure to report bugs

here.

notes.title: Thanksgiving Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Explorers!

We would like to extend our gratitude to your love and support for PixARK. We will continue our work on PixARK and bring to you an even better game. Happy Thanksgiving!

The Thanksgiving update is scheduled to go live at 12:00 am PDT on November 22nd. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/003ff92c0583aa572892a88dd8a9da5de667dbca.jpg

New Gameplay

Since the discovery of Cobalt Ore in Skyward, resulting mutations from the emitting radiation has been observed. Don’t worry, this is something explorers can utilize! 

Added Radiation Mutation Platform. Craftable at level 90. Players can place Pixblocked tames into the Platform. Place the required materials to trigger the mutation. The result will be the creature’s mutated counterpart.
 Added Cobalenergy Golem. Currently the only mutable tame. We’re looking into expanding the list of mutable tames in later patches. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/fe65a72600e3bf5f1bc0d3b5c0c696dd2ae7f74f.jpg

Thanksgiving Gameplay
Thanksgiving Banquet. Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers. 
Pardoned Turkey Event. In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 10% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey, which can take players up in the sky once tamed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cb97d59bff514a9570f70d7b1e705c7ce73cf243.jpg

Thanksgiving Creatures
Pardoned Turkey. While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 10% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey, which can take players up in the sky once tamed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1368cfe638896d9bb641870e5d5b32b71dc0d9d3.jpg

Thanksgiving Dishes: Roasted Turkey, Pumpkin Pie, Beef Wellington, Salad, Brownie, Sweet Potato. All of which may drop from the Supply Beam and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.   
Thanksgiving Equipment Skin: Turkey Hat. Drop from the Supply Beam and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.   
Functional structures
Alien Crop Plot: craftable at level 90 in the Industrial Skill Engram. It is used to plant Cobalt Berries. Cobalt Berry Seed can only be harvested with Cobaltstar Beetle from bushes in Cobalt biomes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/51610f23329c15bbb3a8672647fdf6731cca8c49.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a6a21a59fd1058b432494342d13ce1dcd027bd48.png

 Optimized how tames are released from tame Pixblocks to reduce tame loss.

notes.notes:
Greetings, Explorers!
Halloween is just around the corner, and our next PixARK Halloween update is scheduled to go live around 12:00 am PDT on October 26. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours.

First, let’s take a peek at the Halloween main menu screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f07eee4fa9549992c1a2dfbcdbbcce129f1e6b97.png

New Dungeon/Challenge
To start the Ancient Wyvern King challenge, players will need to Summon an Ancient Wyvern King Challenge Gate and be teleported to where the Wyvern King resides. 

The Challenge Gate can be summoned in the Inscription Book when you put in Dark Magic Stone, Water Magic Stone, Wind Magic Stone, Thunder Magic Stone, Fire Magic Stone, Light Magic Stone, and Earth Magic Stone. You have the chance to produce one of the three different Challenge Gates once the summoning is done. Each of the three Challenge Gate has its own color, size, and summoning rate. The numbers of players and tames allowed to be teleported through these Challenge Gates also vary. 

Once the Challenge Gate is summoned, the dungeon challenge is not activated yet. Players will need to obtain Energy Stone, craftable in the Alchemy Stove, and place them on the Challenge Gate to initiate the portal to the Ancient Wyvern King. If you want to challenge the Ancient Wyvern King for another time, you will have to place Energy Stone to create the portal again. 

Out of the three Ancient Gate, only one can be activated via the Teleportation Platform at a time. A cooldown of 24 hours will be attached to players who have taken on an Ancient Wyvern King challenge. 

Challenge Gate (Blue): summoning rate is 70%; teleport up to 5 players and 5 tames
Challenge Gate (Green): summoning rate is 25%; teleport up to 10 players and 10 tames
Challenge Gate (Purple): summoning rate is 5%; teleport up to 15 players and 15 tames

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/54bcc0a83669b71c421e667c0aa427e79342d947.jpg

New Boss -  Ancient Wyvern King
The Ancient Wyvern drops Wyvern Armor (Wyvern Head Armor, Wyvern Claw Armor, Wyvern Body  Armor, and Wyvern Wing Armor, equitable on Fire Wyvern, Lightning Wyvern, and Poison Wyvern.) It also drops Magic Broom.  

Wyvern Head Armor: reduces damage by 15%; drop rate is 10%
Wyvern Claw Armor: reduces damage by 10%; drop rate is 25%
Wyvern Body  Armor: reduces damage by 15%; drop rate is 40%
Wyvern Wing Armor: reduces damage by 10%; drop rate is 20%
Magic Broom: drop rate is 5%

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ababecd64fc0700a882fa5017ad15326df6c80e6.jpg

New Halloween Creature - Pumpkin Soul Reaper 
Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in these biomes: PixARK - Novice Grassland and Grassland; SkyARK - Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void.

They drop Pumpkin Seed, Limited-Time Magic Broom (spoils in 7 days), and Clown Costume Blueprint.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4fd58e8df4e291dbbe16fcf035bbc7d2ea629be1.gif

New Engram and Items
Limited-Time Magic Broom (Halloween-only): drops from Pumpkin Soul Reaper; includes a spoil timer and disappears once the timer is up. 

Magic Broom: drops from Ancient Wyvern King.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/16e9f2d077f276afb7c50b1dbaef02c66fbd3688.jpg

Halloween Decor: Halloween Trees, Halloween Gravestone, Pumpkin Candle, and Halloween Wall Decor: obtainable from Clown Supply Beam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/83f5209a5e9f9b4b7de0201652fdf2b3456da6d6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cea4745a0b40e43fdbb37fc4289d82edf3378306.jpg

Halloween Clown Costume: Craftable at the Tailor’s Workbench, but first players will need to obtain Clown Costume blueprints from the Pumpkin Soul Reaper. They will need to obtain Pumpkin Seed from Pumpkin Soul Reaper to grow Pumpkin, which is used as a crafting material for Halloween Costume. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/14311252bbb8ed627108bbe7eea0081d22d2dc5a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/812c0ba3c90cff4cce0daddd3d73bd74461434db.png

Halloween Candy Grenade: Throw various Halloween Candy Grenade at other players to turn them into characters wearing various Halloween Masks for ten minutes. Halloween Candy Grenade can be obtained from the Clown Supply Beam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2f522ac0af0e8dd3d6360660d84db3fb008e5587.jpg

Pumpkin Mini Train and Bone Track: create the rail in Halloween style and enjoy a spooky ride.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/011e4afa6573ed66f410c891d7b8bec0c3097d5c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1c222727c6fc594a258f5666429872ada92c2a3d.jpg
		
Halloween In-game Event

Pumpkin Hat: Some creatures will be wearing Pumpkin Hats. There is a chance they can drop the Pumpkin Hat to equip on your tamed creatures. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/941fb48f561841f09c2bb821de990110ee7f760a.gif

Double Harvest Rate: Players will be able to receive double Harvest Rates for Ore during the Halloween Event.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where Cobalt Minotaur could not be tamed by Magic Sleepy Arrow.
Fixed an issue where Cobalt Minotaur could not consume Cobalt Organics as feed.
Fixed an issue where steel structures and other structures above steel-tier could be damaged by Tek Saddle laser and Tek Rifle. 

New Servers
We are also launching a total of eight official servers, all of which are server-transferrable: 

Asia-Pioneering-skyward 4
